items.title: What's included in the MASTER BUNDLE?

children.html: Every LUT, effect, title preset, and creative tool from MoonBear. Including Thermography, Halation, Replica 3, Black & White LUTs + more.

items.title: Is the master bundle a subscription?

children.html: All assets are delivered in industry-standard formats (.cube LUTs, .moef / .moti templates, FCPX/Adobe-compatible presets). They work with Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, CapCut, and Sony Vegas.

items.title: Will I get to download future products free?

children.html: The bundle includes everything current at the time of purchase. Occasionally, we run special promotions for free updates, subscribers to our newsletter will be notified.

Yes. You can use these assets in personal projects, paid client work, YouTube monetization, and more.
